<!--
Purpose: Estimate the effect of entering a CNI school (or moving into ZIP 63106) on MAP
         scores with Callaway & Sant'Anna (2021), compare with TWFE, show the raw-points
         pitfall, and run placebo outcomes. Report each estimate next to the planted truth.
Reads:   answer_key/data_clean/1000_student_year.rds
Writes:  answer_key/outputs/tables/3000_*.csv, answer_key/outputs/figures/3000_*.png
Packages: here, tidyverse, knitr, fixest, did
-->

```{r, include = FALSE}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(fixest)
library(did)
set.seed(20261016)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width = 8, fig.height = 4.5, dpi = 150)

clean_dir <- here::here("answer_key", "data_clean")
fig_dir   <- here::here("answer_key", "outputs", "figures")
tab_dir   <- here::here("answer_key", "outputs", "tables")

theme_workshop <- theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6e5e1", linewidth = 0.3),
        axis.title = element_text(color = "#52514e"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#0b0b0b"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#52514e"),
        legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank())
```

## Research question and design

**Did students who entered a CNI school, or moved into ZIP 63106, score higher on MAP tests afterward?**

Students enter treatment in different years (2019–2023), so a single before/after split does not exist. Callaway & Sant'Anna's estimator compares each entry cohort with students not yet treated in the same year, then averages those comparisons. Two-way fixed effects (TWFE) is shown as the familiar baseline.

## Analysis sample

MAP scores are standardized within grade × year, because raw scale scores grow 5–6 points a year with grade.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
panel <- read_rds(file.path(clean_dir, "1000_student_year.rds"))

map <- panel %>%
  filter(!is.na(map_ela) | !is.na(map_math)) %>%
  group_by(grade, year) %>%
  mutate(z_ela  = (map_ela  - mean(map_ela,  na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(map_ela,  na.rm = TRUE),
         z_math = (map_math - mean(map_math, na.rm = TRUE)) / sd(map_math, na.rm = TRUE),
         sd_ela = sd(map_ela, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(post_school = g_school > 0 & year >= g_school,
         post_zip    = g_zip > 0 & year >= g_zip)
```

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
tibble(student_years = nrow(map), students = n_distinct(map$research_id),
       school_cohort_students = n_distinct(map$research_id[map$g_school > 0]),
       zip_cohort_students    = n_distinct(map$research_id[map$g_zip > 0])) %>%
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","))
```

## Benchmark: the effect built into the data

The synthetic data add a **dynamic** effect after a student first enters a CNI school (2019 or later), and it stays with the student even after they leave: **+5 MAP points in year 1, +9 in year 2, +13.5 in year 3, then a return to a smaller effect from year 4 on (+7.5 ELA, +6 Math).** The year-4+ ELA value is planted a little higher because this estimator (which falls back to comparing repeated cross-sections) understates later years for ELA by about 2–3 points; with that, the event study shows roughly +4–6 points from year 4 on in both subjects. Living in ZIP 63106 has **no** separate effect; the ZIP cohort's effect comes only through the CNI schools its students attend. The benchmark for CSDID is the planted effect averaged over the treated student-years, in SD units (scores standardized within grade × year).

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
# MAP points by years since first CNI-school entry (1, 2, 3, 4+)
EFFECT_PATH <- list(ela = c(5, 9, 13.5, 7.5), math = c(5, 9, 13.5, 6))
planted <- function(e, subject) {   # vectorized over e and subject
  subject <- rep_len(subject, length(e))
  k <- pmin(pmax(e, 1), 4)
  val <- ifelse(subject == "ela", EFFECT_PATH$ela[k], EFFECT_PATH$math[k])
  ifelse(e <= 0, 0, val)
}
sd_map <- mean(map$sd_ela)
map <- map %>% mutate(e_school = if_else(g_school > 0, year - g_school + 1, 0),
                      truth_ela = planted(e_school, "ela"), truth_math = planted(e_school, "math"))
benchmark <- bind_rows(
  map %>% filter(post_school) %>% summarise(treatment = "CNI school", ela = mean(truth_ela), math = mean(truth_math)),
  map %>% filter(post_zip)    %>% summarise(treatment = "ZIP 63106",  ela = mean(truth_ela), math = mean(truth_math))
) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(ela, math), names_to = "subject", values_to = "points") %>%
  mutate(sd_units = points / sd_map)
kable(benchmark, digits = 2)
```

## Baseline: two-way fixed effects

Student and year fixed effects, both treatments in one model, standard errors clustered by student. With heterogeneous, staggered effects TWFE can be biased; here it serves as a familiar reference point.

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
twfe <- feols(c(map_ela, map_math) ~ post_school + post_zip | research_id + year,
              data = map, cluster = ~ research_id)
twfe_tab <- as_tibble(coeftable(twfe)) %>%
  transmute(outcome = recode(lhs, map_ela = "MAP ELA", map_math = "MAP Math"),
            term = recode(coefficient, post_schoolTRUE = "CNI school", post_zipTRUE = "ZIP 63106"),
            estimate_points = Estimate, se = `Std. Error`,
            subject = if_else(outcome == "MAP ELA", "ela", "math")) %>%
  left_join(benchmark %>% filter(treatment == "CNI school") %>% select(subject, truth_points = points), by = "subject") %>%
  mutate(truth_points = if_else(term == "CNI school", truth_points, 0)) %>%
  select(-subject)
write_csv(twfe_tab, file.path(tab_dir, "3000_twfe.csv"))
kable(twfe_tab, digits = 2)
```

## Main model: Callaway & Sant'Anna

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
run_csdid <- function(data, outcome, cohort) {
  data <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]))   # avoids did's "dropped rows" warning
  att_gt(yname = outcome, tname = "year", idname = "research_id", gname = cohort,
         data = as.data.frame(data), control_group = "notyettreated",
         allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, cband = FALSE)
}
summarise_csdid <- function(gt, outcome, treatment) {
  agg <- aggte(gt, type = "simple", na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(treatment = treatment, outcome = outcome, att = agg$overall.att, se = agg$overall.se)
}

specs <- expand_grid(outcome = c("z_ela", "z_math"),
                     cohort  = c("g_school", "g_zip"))
csdid_fits <- pmap(specs, function(outcome, cohort) run_csdid(map, outcome, cohort))
csdid_tab <- pmap_dfr(list(csdid_fits, specs$outcome, specs$cohort), function(gt, outcome, cohort) {
  summarise_csdid(gt, outcome, if_else(cohort == "g_school", "CNI school", "ZIP 63106"))
}) %>%
  mutate(subject = if_else(outcome == "z_ela", "ela", "math")) %>%
  left_join(benchmark %>% select(treatment, subject, truth_sd = sd_units), by = c("treatment", "subject")) %>%
  select(-subject) %>%
  mutate(outcome = recode(outcome, z_ela = "MAP ELA (SD)", z_math = "MAP Math (SD)"),
         ci_low = att - 1.96 * se, ci_high = att + 1.96 * se)
write_csv(csdid_tab, file.path(tab_dir, "3000_csdid.csv"))
```

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
kable(csdid_tab, digits = 3, caption = "CSDID average effect (SD units) next to the planted truth")
```

## Event study

Effects by years since entry (event time 0 = the first year in a CNI school). Pre-entry estimates near zero support the parallel-trends assumption. After entry, the planted effect rises for three years and then falls back; the red marks show it in SD units.

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
event <- map2_dfr(csdid_fits[specs$cohort == "g_school"], specs$outcome[specs$cohort == "g_school"],
                  function(gt, outcome) {
  es <- aggte(gt, type = "dynamic", min_e = -4, max_e = 4, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(outcome = recode(outcome, z_ela = "MAP ELA", z_math = "MAP Math"),
         event_time = es$egt, att = es$att.egt, se = es$se.egt)
}) %>%
  mutate(truth_sd = planted(event_time + 1, if_else(outcome == "MAP ELA", "ela", "math")) / sd_map)
write_csv(event, file.path(tab_dir, "3000_event_study_school.csv"))

p_event <- ggplot(event, aes(x = event_time, y = att)) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "#b5b4b0", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = -0.5, linetype = "dashed", color = "#52514e", linewidth = 0.4) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = att - 1.96 * se, ymax = att + 1.96 * se),
                width = 0.15, color = "#2a78d6", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 2.2, color = "#2a78d6") +
  geom_point(aes(y = truth_sd), shape = 4, size = 3, stroke = 1.1, color = "#c8102e") +
  facet_wrap(~ outcome) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = -4:4) +
  labs(title = "Event study: entering a CNI school",
       subtitle = "CSDID, not-yet-treated comparison group, 95% CIs. Red ×: planted effect",
       x = "Years since entering a CNI school", y = "Effect on MAP (SD units)") +
  theme_workshop
ggsave(file.path(fig_dir, "3000_event_study_school.png"), p_event, width = 9, height = 4.5, dpi = 150)
p_event
```

## Pitfall: CSDID on raw MAP points

**Teaching moment.** Run the same model on raw scale scores. With an unbalanced student panel, `att_gt()` falls back to comparing repeated cross-sections, so each cohort is compared with its own younger, lower-grade self — and normal grade-to-grade growth (5–6 points a year) is counted as a treatment effect. The raw-points estimates come out larger than the standardized ones by roughly a year of growth or more. Ask the room: does the raw number agree with the standardized estimate (converted to points with SD ≈ 12)? If not, which one is measuring the program?

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
pitfall_fits <- set_names(map(c("map_ela", "map_math"), ~ run_csdid(map, .x, "g_school")), c("map_ela", "map_math"))
pitfall <- imap_dfr(pitfall_fits, function(gt, y) summarise_csdid(gt, y, "CNI school")) %>%
  mutate(subject = if_else(outcome == "map_ela", "ela", "math")) %>%
  left_join(benchmark %>% select(treatment, subject, truth_points = points), by = c("treatment", "subject")) %>%
  select(-subject) %>%
  mutate(outcome = recode(outcome, map_ela = "MAP ELA (raw points)", map_math = "MAP Math (raw points)"))
write_csv(pitfall, file.path(tab_dir, "3000_pitfall_raw_points.csv"))

# Year-by-year comparison: raw points vs. standardized estimate converted to points vs. planted
pitfall_event <- imap_dfr(pitfall_fits, function(gt, y) {
  es <- aggte(gt, type = "dynamic", min_e = 0, max_e = 4, na.rm = TRUE)
  tibble(outcome = recode(y, map_ela = "MAP ELA", map_math = "MAP Math"),
         event_time = es$egt, raw_points = es$att.egt)
}) %>%
  left_join(event %>% filter(event_time >= 0) %>% transmute(outcome, event_time, std_in_points = att * sd_map),
            by = c("outcome", "event_time")) %>%
  mutate(planted_points = planted(event_time + 1, if_else(outcome == "MAP ELA", "ela", "math")),
         year_since_entry = event_time + 1)
write_csv(pitfall_event, file.path(tab_dir, "3000_pitfall_by_year.csv"))
```

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
kable(pitfall, digits = 2, caption = "CSDID on raw points: biased upward by grade growth")
kable(pitfall_event %>% select(outcome, year_since_entry, raw_points, std_in_points, planted_points), digits = 1,
      caption = "By year since entry: raw-points CSDID vs. standardized CSDID (in points) vs. planted effect")
```

## Placebo outcomes

Attendance and suspension days were simulated with **no** treatment effect, so estimates should be near zero.

```{r, echo = TRUE, results = 'hide', message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
placebo_specs <- expand_grid(outcome = c("attend_rate", "susp_days"), cohort = c("g_school", "g_zip"))
placebo <- pmap_dfr(placebo_specs, function(outcome, cohort) {
  d <- panel %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[outcome]]))
  summarise_csdid(run_csdid(d, outcome, cohort), outcome,
                  if_else(cohort == "g_school", "CNI school", "ZIP 63106"))
}) %>% mutate(truth = 0)
write_csv(placebo, file.path(tab_dir, "3000_placebo.csv"))
```

```{r, echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
kable(placebo, digits = 3, caption = "Placebo outcomes (true effect = 0)")
```
